network-linear-cost/1.formula: sum over t of p[t] x w_generators[t], summed over the network's generators
network-linear-cost/1.validity: each snapshot needs a verified LP solve (else unverified_solve), capacity >= 0, p within capacity x [p_min_pu, p_max_pu] +/- 1e-8 and its inputs present with weight > 0; one excluded snapshot makes it unavailable (invalid_or_missing_raw_data, partial value labelled). Refusals: unsupported_snapshot_scope, unknown_generator, misaligned_source, missing_dispatch, unsupported_generator_sign

network-linear-cost/1.formula: sum over t of p[t] x marginal_cost[t] x w_objective[t], summed over the network's generators
network-linear-cost/1.validity: each snapshot needs a verified LP solve (else unverified_solve), capacity >= 0, p within capacity x [p_min_pu, p_max_pu] +/- 1e-8 and its inputs present with weight > 0; one excluded snapshot makes it unavailable (invalid_or_missing_raw_data, partial value labelled). Refusals: unsupported_snapshot_scope, unknown_generator, misaligned_source, missing_dispatch, unsupported_generator_sign; in a cost profile also withheld with the cost reason when the cost population is not linear

network-linear-cost/1.formula: max over t of sum over generators of p[t]
network-linear-cost/1.validity: each snapshot needs a verified LP solve (else unverified_solve), capacity >= 0, p within capacity x [p_min_pu, p_max_pu] +/- 1e-8 and its inputs present with weight > 0; one excluded snapshot makes it unavailable (invalid_or_missing_raw_data, partial value labelled). Refusals: unsupported_snapshot_scope, unknown_generator, misaligned_source, missing_dispatch, unsupported_generator_sign

network-linear-cost/1.formula: sum of capacity x capital_cost over the generators and passive branches (capacity = p_nom_opt if extendable else p_nom)
network-linear-cost/1.validity: needs an explicit cost basis (else explicit_cost_basis_required), a linear non-committable cost model with no unsupported cost components, a verified solve, and every capacity and capital_cost finite and >= 0 (else unsupported_or_invalid_cost_population)
